# BotFn

> Discord and Slack bot integrations, issue linking, persistence, and operator controls.

## Documentation

- [Administration capability](https://botfn.com/docs/admin) — Integrate BotFn operator resources with Super Console.
- [Discord bot](https://botfn.com/docs/discord-bot) — Configure signed interactions, issue commands, and the Worker.
- [Getting started](https://botfn.com/docs/getting-started) — Find the BotFn package or service that fits your integration.
- [BotFn](https://botfn.com/docs) — Build and operate Discord and Slack bot integrations.
- [Integration helpers](https://botfn.com/docs/integrations) — Reuse Discord, Slack, GitHub, Linear, and schema helpers.
- [Operations and limits](https://botfn.com/docs/operations-and-limits) — Deployment responsibilities and current feature boundaries.
- [Persistence service](https://botfn.com/docs/persistence) — Store issue and Discord thread relationships through tRPC.
- [Commands and routes](https://botfn.com/docs/reference/commands-and-routes) — BotFn's registered commands, Worker routes, and tRPC procedures.
- [Configuration](https://botfn.com/docs/reference/configuration) — Runtime bindings and deployment inputs by package.
- [Reference](https://botfn.com/docs/reference) — BotFn package and runtime contract index.
- [Packages](https://botfn.com/docs/reference/packages) — Current BotFn package map and entry points.
- [Slack receiver](https://botfn.com/docs/slack-bot) — Verify Slack requests and understand the current event handler.
